newsitem.title: USA: IMF official denies easing loan terms for Russia.
newsitem.headline: IMF official denies easing loan terms for Russia.

text.p: A senior International Monetary Fund official on Monday denied that the IMF had eased loan conditions for Russia and praised Moscow for its "outstanding" performance in keeping to its reform plan.
"We have not softened at all our program," the official, who declined to be named, told reporters ahead of the start of the annual IMF/World Bank meeting here later this week.
He said that Russia's reform program has remained on track, with inflation down and the rouble stable. The IMF last year agreed to lend Russia about $10 billion over three years.
